title: Your next book is closer.
summary: Discover 5,000 complete books across the collection, with a fresh selection each time you open the app. Add your next read straight to your personal shelf.

title: Make reading yours.
summary: Choose your desk, paper and hardcover. Set the mood with ambience, adjust EPUB typography and follow your reading rhythm.

title: Take your library along.
summary: Back up your books and reading progress, transfer them between devices and export your notes. Reopen saved books offline.

title: More ways to stay with the story.
summary: Highlight, draw, bookmark and write margin notes. Listen aloud, look up a word or prepare your next book from your own documents.

title: A shelf full of possibilities.
summary: Discover complete classics by title, author or genre. Explore book details and add your next read to your own library.

title: Your private reading room.
summary: Book-style page turns, a personal shelf and a place to pick up where you left off. Free to read, with no account needed.
